title: Pipe-bend sofa, exact
words: Find and prove the optimal solid for a round pipe with a right-angle bend.
math: Determine the maximal volume and an optimizer for the diameter-1 circular pipe with a right-angle bend.

title: One firefighter on hats
words: Can a single firefighter per turn contain every fire on a hat tiling?
math: Decide whether one protected vertex per turn contains any single-vertex fire on the hat graph.

title: Blank jigsaw
words: A jigsaw with no picture can only be solved from piece shapes. How few edge shapes force a unique solution?
math: Find the asymptotics in $n$ of the least number of edge types such that some $n\times n$ jigsaw has exactly one assembly (up to rotation of the whole).

title: Hat billiard scarring
words: Show high-frequency waves in a hat-shaped room do not spread out evenly.
math: Prove quantum unique ergodicity fails for the hat polygon: some subsequence of eigenfunctions has a non-uniform limit measure.

title: Convex sofa
words: Find the best convex sofa.
math: Maximize area over convex sets admissible in the width-1 right-angled corridor.

title: Fire on a random hat patch
words: Remove each hat tile with some probability. Find the exact point where a fire can no longer burn forever.
math: Prove the site-percolation threshold of the hat tiling exists as a single sharp value and bound it within $10^{-4}$.

title: Hadwiger below 100
words: Find a Hadwiger counterexample needing at most 100 colors.
math: Find $G$ with $\chi(G)=t\le100$ and no $K_t$ minor, or prove Hadwiger's conjecture holds for all $t\le100$.

title: Three-pile shuffle inverse
words: Find a formula for how many three-pile shuffles undo one three-pile shuffle.
math: For the 3-pile shuffle permutation $\sigma_n$ on $3n$ cards, prove $\operatorname{ord}(\sigma_n)$ is not bounded by any polynomial in $n$ along a positive-density set of $n$.

title: Hat Ising critical temperature
words: Find the exact critical temperature for magnets on a hat tiling.
math: Compute $\beta_c$ of the Ising model on the hat adjacency graph in closed form.

title: Integer Keller collision
words: Find a polynomial map with Jacobian exactly 1 and integer coefficients that sends two different integer points to the same place.
math: Find $F\in\mathbb{Z}[x,y,z]^3$ with $\det DF\equiv1$ and distinct $a,b\in\mathbb{Z}^3$ with $F(a)=F(b)$.

title: Delayed fire on hexagons
words: On a honeycomb grid, firefighters arrive one turn late. Find how many per turn are needed.
math: On the hexagonal lattice with 3-neighbour spread and one-turn protection delay, find the least per-turn budget containing a single fire.

title: Between exponent and tetration
words: Find natural rules that fix a unique operation between exponentiation and tetration.
math: Find axioms that uniquely determine $a[s]b$ for real $s\in[3,4]$ extending $\uparrow,\uparrow\uparrow$ with the recursion law, and prove uniqueness.

title: Keller maps classification
words: List every Jacobian-conjecture counterexample in 3D, up to symmetry.
math: Classify all non-invertible Keller maps $\mathbb{C}^3\to\mathbb{C}^3$ up to composition with polynomial automorphisms.

title: Keller maps with few terms
words: Find a Jacobian-conjecture counterexample using as few polynomial terms as possible.
math: Minimize the total number of monomials of $F:\mathbb{C}^3\to\mathbb{C}^3$ with $\det DF\in\mathbb{C}^\times$ and $F$ not injective; prove minimality.

title: Hat billiard counting
words: Count the periodic bouncing paths inside a hat-shaped table up to a given length.
math: For billiards in the hat polygon, prove $N(L)\sim cL^2$ for periodic cylinder families and compute $c$.

title: Sofa stability
words: Show that any sofa nearly as big as Gerver's must look nearly like Gerver's.
math: Prove a quantitative stability bound: $A(S)\ge A_G-\varepsilon$ implies $d_H(S,G)\le C\varepsilon^{\alpha}$ up to rigid motion.

title: Random voice leading
words: For random chord progressions, find how total voice movement grows.
math: For i.i.d. uniform $k$-note chords in $\mathbb{Z}_{12}$, prove the minimal total voice-leading cost over $n$ chords is $\sim c_k n$ and compute $c_k$.

title: Survive Tetris forever
words: With the modern 7-bag randomizer and full knowledge of upcoming pieces, can you play forever?
math: Decide whether the player can survive indefinitely on a $10\times20$ well against all 7-bag sequences with infinite preview.

title: A human unit-distance record
words: AI broke an 80-year-old conjecture by placing points with many equal distances. Beat its exponent with a construction humans can follow.
math: Give an explicit, human-checkable construction of $n$-point planar sets with $\ge n^{1.02}$ unit distances for infinitely many $n$.

title: Cylinder Connect Four
words: Connect Four where the left and right edges wrap around. Who wins on a standard 7 × 6 board?
math: Solve Connect Four on $7\times6$ with columns cyclic (lines may wrap horizontally and diagonally).

title: Wang busy beaver is eventually beyond ZFC
words: Find the smallest n where the Wang-tile busy beaver value cannot be proven in standard set theory.
math: Determine the least $n$ for which the value of $W(n)$ is independent of ZFC.

title: Gerver sofa is not periodic in its digits
words: Show the digits of Gerver's sofa area never fall into a repeating pattern in any base, and are not "too well" approximable.
math: Prove the irrationality measure of $\mu_G$ equals 2.

title: Counting doubled twins
words: Show doubled-twin primes (p, p + 2, 2p + 1, 2p + 3 all prime) are rare, using a sieve.
math: Prove $\#\{p\le x: p,\,p+2,\,2p+1,\,2p+3 \text{ prime}\}\ll x/(\log x)^4$.

title: Hyperoperation transcendence
words: Show values of the natural hyperoperation at non-integer ranks are algebraically independent.
math: Prove $\{2[s]3: s\in\mathbb{Q}\cap(2,3)\}$ is algebraically independent over $\mathbb{Q}$.

title: Wang busy beaver growth
words: Show the "busy beaver" for Wang tiles grows faster than any computable function, with an explicit first non-trivial value.
math: Define $W(n)$ as the largest finite region tiled by $n$ Wang tiles that cannot be extended; prove $W(5)$ and give its value.

title: Toroidal Othello
words: Who wins Othello on an 8 × 8 board that wraps around?
math: Weakly solve Othello on $\mathbb{Z}_8^2$ with standard initial position.

title: Unattained hyperbolic sofa
words: In strongly curved hyperbolic space the best sofa might not exist. Show when the maximum is never reached.
math: Find $\kappa_0$ such that for curvature $-\kappa<-\kappa_0$ the hyperbolic sofa supremum is not attained.

title: Sudoku symmetry breaking
words: Show that most big Sudoku grids have no symmetry at all.
math: Prove the proportion of $n^2\times n^2$ Sudoku grids with nontrivial automorphism tends to 0.

title: Hyperbolic sofa, flat limit
words: As curvature fades to zero, the best hyperbolic sofa should approach Gerver's sofa. Find how fast.
math: Let $A(\kappa)$ be the optimal sofa area in curvature $-\kappa$. Prove $A(\kappa)=2.2195\ldots+c\kappa+o(\kappa)$ and compute $c$.

title: Polykite growth constant
words: Count shapes made of n kites. Find the exponential growth rate to three digits.
math: Let $k_n$ count polykites with $n$ kites up to congruence. Prove $k_n^{1/n}\to\lambda$ and compute $\lambda$ to 3 digits.

title: Chen meets Sophie Germain
words: Show infinitely many primes p have 2p + 1 prime and p + 2 a product of at most two primes.
math: Prove infinitely many primes $p$ with $2p+1$ prime and $\Omega(p+2)\le2$.

title: Integer sofa
words: With the hallway scaled to width 10, what is the biggest polygon with whole-number corners that turns the corner?
math: Maximize area over lattice polygons admissible in the width-10 right-angled corridor.

title: Kakeya discs
words: What is the least volume needed to turn a flat disc to every orientation?
math: Determine $\inf$ volume of sets in $\mathbb{R}^3$ containing a unit disc in every orientation (positive by Marstrand), with an extremizer.

title: Three-pile shuffle group
words: Using the six ways to stack three piles in a perfect shuffle, which rearrangements of the deck can you reach?
math: Determine the subgroup of $S_{3n}$ generated by the six 3-pile perfect shuffles (all pile orders), for every $n$.

title: Two of four
words: Show infinitely many primes p have at least one more prime among p + 2, 2p + 1, 2p + 3.
math: Prove infinitely many primes $p$ have at least one of $p+2,\,2p+1,\,2p+3$ prime.

title: Gerver constant is normal
words: Show the digits of Gerver's sofa area appear with equal frequency in base 10.
math: Prove $\mu_G$ is normal in base 10.

title: Yang–Mills on hats
words: Lattice gauge theory placed on a hat tiling should still have a mass gap at strong coupling and at weak coupling.
math: Prove the $SU(2)$ lattice gauge theory on the 3D product of the hat complex and $\mathbb{Z}$ has a mass gap for all couplings.

title: Sparse Keller maps
words: List every Jacobian-conjecture counterexample in 3D built from at most 12 monomials in total, up to symmetry.
math: Classify all non-invertible Keller maps $\mathbb{C}^3\to\mathbb{C}^3$ whose three components together have at most 12 monomials, up to affine changes of coordinates.

title: Four-arc sofa
words: Find the best sofa whose outline uses at most four circular arcs and straight pieces.
math: Maximize area over admissible sofas whose boundary consists of at most four circular arcs plus segments.

title: Unbounded Prime Nim
words: Do the Prime Nim values grow without limit?
math: Decide whether $\sup_n G(n)=\infty$ for the prime subtraction game.

title: BB(5), compressed
words: The Busy Beaver value BB(5) was proved with a large computer proof. Make it small.
math: Prove $BB(5)=47{,}176{,}870$ in Lean 4 in under 10,000 lines.

title: Overlap gap at density 4
words: Show random 3-SAT at density 4 has a structural barrier that stops all local algorithms.
math: Prove the overlap-gap property for random 3-SAT at density $4.0$ and deduce failure of all low-degree polynomial algorithms.

title: 46 multiplications
words: Multiply two 4 × 4 matrices over the two-element field with only 46 multiplications.
math: Find a bilinear algorithm of rank 46 for $\langle4,4,4\rangle$ over $\mathbb{F}_2$, or prove rank $\ge47$.

title: Sofa in curved space with a corner
words: On a cone-shaped surface the hallway corner is the cone point. Find the best sofa.
math: For the width-1 corridor on a flat cone of angle $\alpha$ with the inner corner at the apex, find the optimal sofa area as a function of $\alpha$.

title: Coloring the spectre's distances
words: Take all corners of a spectre tiling and join two whenever they are exactly one edge-length apart. How many colors are needed?
math: Determine the chromatic number of the unit-distance graph on the vertex set of a spectre tiling (unit = edge length).

title: Minimal four-color proof
words: The four color theorem's proof checks a big list of map configurations. Find the smallest list that works.
math: Determine the minimum size of an unavoidable set of reducible configurations for planar triangulations, with proof of minimality.

title: Square-sum expansion
words: Show the square-sum graph (on its large connected piece) is a good expander.
math: Prove the giant component of $S_N$ has spectral gap at least $(\log N)^{-C}$.

title: Two fires
words: Two fires start a distance d apart. How many firefighters per turn are needed, depending on d?
math: On $\mathbb{Z}^2$ with 4-neighbour spread, find the least $k(d)$ containing fires started at $(0,0)$ and $(d,0)$.

title: Seven-free Egyptian fractions
words: Write every fraction as a sum of distinct unit fractions whose denominators never contain the digit 7.
math: Prove every $q\in\mathbb{Q}\cap(0,1)$ is $\sum_{d\in D}1/d$ for a finite set $D$ of distinct integers with no decimal digit 7.

title: Shrink to fit
words: Find the largest size such that every convex shape no wider than that, measured end to end, gets around the corner.
math: Find the largest $d$ such that every planar convex body of diameter $\le d$ is admissible in the width-1 right-angled corridor.

title: Statement-mismatch attack
words: Build a Lean proof that passes every standard checker but whose statement quietly means something other than intended, then show how to catch it.
math: Construct a Lean 4 development accepted by kernel replay and Comparator whose main theorem differs from a stated informal intent; give a decision procedure flagging this class.

title: Squares on a torus
words: Every contractible closed curve on a flat doughnut should pass through the corners of a square.
math: Prove every contractible Jordan curve on the flat torus $\mathbb{R}^2/\mathbb{Z}^2$ inscribes a square.

title: Spectre gap labelling
words: Show every allowed energy gap of the spectre tiling actually opens.
math: Prove the dry ten-Martini property for the adjacency operator on the spectre tiling.

title: Counting Prime Nim losses
words: Show the losing positions of Prime Nim thin out at a precise power rate.
math: Prove $|L\cap[1,x]|=x^{\alpha+o(1)}$ for some $\alpha$ and compute it.

title: Remove the suspicious definition
words: A critic flagged a definition in the 2026 Riemann proof that is always true. Show the proof survives without it.
math: Produce a variant of the 2026 Lean RH development in which `anyGeometry` is removed or replaced by a non-constant predicate, still kernel-checked.

title: Tangent-sweep Keller maps
words: One 2026 counterexample to the Jacobian conjecture sweeps tangent lines of a curve. Find every counterexample built that way.
math: Classify all polynomial maps $\mathbb{C}^3\to\mathbb{C}^3$ with constant nonzero Jacobian arising from the tangent-sweep construction over plane curves.

title: Hat random walk return
words: Find the exact probability that a random walk on hat tiles returns to its start within n steps, asymptotically.
math: Prove $p_{2n}(o,o)\sim c/n$ on the hat graph and compute $c$ exactly.

title: Quoridor
words: Who wins the board game Quoridor with perfect play?
math: Weakly solve two-player Quoridor on the $9\times9$ board with 10 walls each.

title: Emirp twins
words: Show infinitely many twin-prime pairs exist where both reverse to primes, assuming only standard sieve bounds plus one level-of-distribution hypothesis.
math: Assuming Elliott–Halberstam, prove infinitely many $p$ with $p,p+2,\operatorname{rev}(p),\operatorname{rev}(p+2)$ prime among bounded gaps of tuples $(p,p+h)$, $h\le H$ explicit.

title: Kissing hats
words: How many copies of the hat tile can touch one hat without overlapping?
math: Determine the maximum number of interior-disjoint congruent copies of the hat polykite, reflections allowed, each meeting a fixed hat.

title: Delayed fire on the grid
words: If the fire only spreads every other turn, find the smallest per-turn budget that always contains it.
math: Find the infimum of average firefighter budgets that contain the half-speed fire on $\mathbb{Z}^2$.

title: Reverse-square map dynamics
words: Square a number then reverse its digits, repeatedly. Show almost every start grows forever.
math: Prove $R^k(n)\to\infty$ for a density-one set of $n$, where $R(n)=\operatorname{rev}(n^2)$.

title: Homogenized wildfire
words: Fire spreads through random patches of two fuel types. Show it has a definite average speed and compute it.
math: For the eikonal equation with i.i.d. two-valued speed on a lattice, prove homogenization and give the effective speed in closed form.

title: Hat patch complexity
words: Count the distinct round patches of radius r in hat tilings. Find the exact constant in their growth.
math: Let $P(r)$ count radius-$r$ patches over the hat tiling hull. Prove $P(r)\sim C r^2$ and compute $C$.

title: Prime-graceful trees
words: Label every tree so edge differences are distinct primes.
math: Prove every tree has an injective labeling into $\mathbb{Z}_{\ge0}$ whose edge differences are distinct primes, using labels $\le Cm\log m$.

title: Random-wind fire
words: The wind changes randomly every turn. Show two firefighters per turn still trap the fire with certainty.
math: On $\mathbb{Z}^2$, each turn fire spreads to 3 of 4 neighbours, omitting an i.i.d. uniform direction. Prove 2 protections per turn contain it almost surely.

title: Tetris on a cylinder
words: When the board wraps left to right, can a player survive forever against any piece sequence?
math: Decide whether a player can survive indefinitely in a width-10 cylindrical Tetris well against adversarial piece sequences with 1-piece preview.

title: Three of four
words: Show infinitely often at least three of the four doubled-twin numbers are prime at once.
math: Prove there are infinitely many $n$ such that at least three of $n,n+2,2n+1,2n+3$ are prime.

title: Three-pile shuffle orders equal
words: Show the three-pile shuffle and the two-pile shuffle on the same deck size have equal order infinitely often.
math: Prove $\operatorname{ord}(\sigma^{(3)}_{6n})=\operatorname{ord}(\sigma^{(2)}_{6n})$ for infinitely many $n$.

title: Polykite Heesch record
words: A shape that cannot tile the plane can still be surrounded by copies of itself a few times. Find the record among shapes of up to 8 kites.
math: Among non-tiling polykites with $\le8$ kites, determine the maximum Heesch number.

title: Where did the fire start?
words: From the final burn scar and the wind record, recover where a fire started, and show the answer is unique.
math:
For the eikonal model $|
abla T|\,v(
abla T/|
abla T|,w)=1$ with known anisotropic speed, prove the ignition point is determined by the burned region at time $T$ under explicit conditions.

title: Kayles on square sums
words: Players take turns claiming numbers, never next to a claimed one in the square-sum graph. Who wins?
math: Determine the node-Kayles outcome on $S_N$ for all $N$.

title: Isoperimetric sofa
words: Among sofas with a fixed perimeter, find the one with largest area that turns the corner.
math: For each $L$, maximize area over corridor-admissible sets of perimeter $\le L$.

title: Packing hats
words: Find the densest way to pack hat shapes when they are not allowed to tile.
math: Determine the maximal packing density of translates and rotations of the hat with reflections forbidden.

title: Random hat parking
words: Drop hat tiles at random without overlap until no more fit. What fraction gets covered?
math: Compute the jamming density of random sequential adsorption of hats (random rotations from the kite grid) in the plane.

title: Sofa through a revolving corridor
words: The hallway itself slowly rotates while you push the sofa. Find the largest sofa that still makes it.
math: For the width-1 L-corridor rotating at angular speed $\omega$ relative to a sofa moving at unit speed, find the optimal area as a function of $\omega$.

title: Two-tree graceful forests
words: Check the distinct-difference labeling for every forest of two small trees.
math: Prove that every forest of two trees with at most 25 vertices each has a bijection $V\to\{0,\dots,m+1\}$ with distinct edge differences.

title: Hat tiling Lee–Yang zeros
words: For magnets on a hat tiling, show the complex zeros of the partition function pinch the real axis at exactly one point.
math: Prove the Lee–Yang zeros of the ferromagnetic Ising model on growing hat patches accumulate on the positive real temperature axis only at $\beta_c$.

title: Three-pile shuffle cutoff
words: Random three-pile shuffles mix a deck suddenly, after a precise number of shuffles. Find it.
math: For random compositions of uniformly chosen 3-pile shuffles on $3n$ cards, prove total-variation cutoff at $c\log n$ and find $c$.

title: Galois groups of Keller fibers
words: Find the symmetry group of the preimages of a point under the 2026 Keller maps.
math: Compute the Galois group of the generic fiber of Gallagher's degree-$n$ Keller family for each $n\ge3$.

title: Isospectral polykites
words: Two different drums can sound the same. Find two different shapes made of kites that do.
math: Find two non-congruent polykites whose Dirichlet Laplacians have identical spectra.

title: Packing seven-pointed stars
words: Find the densest way to pack identical seven-pointed stars in the plane.
math: Determine the maximal packing density of congruent copies of the regular star polygon $\{7/2\}$.

title: Spot fires
words: Fires throw embers ahead at random. Find the exact spreading speed.
math: For a growth model where each burning site ignites a site at i.i.d. heavy-tailed displacement at rate 1, compute the asymptotic speed or growth exponent explicitly.

title: Cube-sum independence
words: Find the largest set of numbers up to N where no two add to a cube.
math: Determine $\alpha(C_N)$ asymptotically, with second-order term.

title: Hyperbolic triangle peg
words: Every smooth closed curve in the hyperbolic plane should contain the corners of equilateral triangles of many sizes.
math: For a smooth Jordan curve $\gamma\subset\mathbb{H}^2$, prove there is $s_0(\gamma)>0$ such that $\gamma$ inscribes a hyperbolic equilateral triangle of every side length $s\le s_0$.

title: Lonely runner with one fast runner
words: Runners have speeds 1, 2, 3 and some larger speed m. Work out exactly how lonely a stationary runner is guaranteed to get, depending on m.
math: Compute $\delta(m)=\sup_t\min(\|t\|,\|2t\|,\|3t\|,\|mt\|)$ in closed form for all integers $m\ge4$.

title: Random square-sum graphs
words: Replace "perfect squares" with a random set of the same sparsity. When does a full arrangement in a circle appear?
math: For random $Q\subset\mathbb{N}$ with $\Pr(q\in Q)=q^{-1/2}$, find the threshold for Hamiltonicity of the graph $a\sim b\iff a+b\in Q$ on $[N]$.

title: Quarter-tone all-interval rows
words: Count the tone rows in 24-note tuning that use every interval exactly once.
math: Count permutations of $\mathbb{Z}_{24}$ whose successive differences are all distinct nonzero residues, and find their growth rate for $\mathbb{Z}_{2m}$.

title: Doubled-twin parity
words: Show doubled-twin primes end in 1 and 9 equally often in the long run, with an explicit power-saving error.
math: Prove the count of doubled-twin $p\le x$ with $p\equiv1\pmod{10}$ equals half the total plus $O(x^{1-\delta})$.

title: High-dimensional sofa
words: How does the best sofa's volume grow in an n-dimensional corridor?
math: Determine the asymptotics in $n$ of the optimal volume in the $n$-dimensional right-angled corridor of unit cross-section.

title: Self-similar fire
words: Show a fire spreading with random fuel forms a shape that grows at a fixed limiting speed in every direction.
math: For first-passage percolation on the hat graph with i.i.d. exponential weights, prove the limit shape exists and is not a polygon.

title: Three-pile shuffle
words: Deal a deck into three equal piles and interleave them, keeping the top and bottom cards fixed. How many times until the deck returns to its original order?
math: For a deck of $3n$ cards, show the 3-pile out-shuffle has order $\operatorname{ord}_{3n-1}(3)$. For 54 cards this is 52.

title: Seven-free Carmichael numbers
words: Show infinitely many Carmichael numbers have no digit 7.
math: Prove there are infinitely many Carmichael numbers with no digit 7 in base 10.

title: Narrowing doorway sofa
words: A width-1 hallway turns a right angle and then narrows to width 0.8. Find the biggest sofa that gets through.
math: Maximize the area of a connected planar set movable from arm $\mathbb{R}_{<0}\times[0,1]$ into arm $[0,0.8]\times\mathbb{R}_{>1}$.

title: Real-rank hyperoperation uniqueness
words: Prove there is exactly one natural way to fill in the operations between addition, multiplication and powers.
math: Prove uniqueness of an analytic family $a[s]b$ on $s\in[1,3]$ under the recursion law plus a log-convexity condition in $s$, and existence.

title: Prime Nim, misère
words: In Prime Nim where the last mover loses instead of wins, do the losing positions differ from normal play only finitely often?
math: Compare the P-positions of the prime subtraction game in normal and misère play; decide whether their symmetric difference is finite.

title: Random walk on the hat tiling
words: A random walker steps between neighbouring hat tiles. How likely is it to be back home after n steps?
math: For simple random walk on the hat adjacency graph, prove $p_{2n}(o,o)\sim c/n$ and compute $c$.

title: Prime Nim is not simple
words: Show Prime Nim losing positions cannot be detected by shallow constant-depth circuits.
math: Prove the indicator of P-positions of the prime subtraction game (in binary) is not in $\mathsf{AC}^0$.

title: Monotile assembly threshold
words: With one tile shape, deciding whether a region can be tiled is easy in some cases; with many shapes it is hard. Find the smallest number of shapes where it becomes hard.
math: Find the least $t$ such that some fixed set of $t$ polygons makes "does this finite region admit an exact tiling?" NP-complete, and prove all sets of fewer polygons give polynomial-time problems.

title: Delayed firefighters
words: Fire spreads in four directions, but a firefighter assigned now only takes effect a turn later. How many per turn are needed?
math: On $\mathbb{Z}^2$ with 4-neighbour spread, cells chosen at turn $t$ become protected at turn $t+1$. Find the least per-turn number that contains a single fire.
